input.detail: Created src/app/api/notion/tasks/route.ts. Key decisions: (1) @notionhq/client v5.22.0 uses dataSources.query({data_source_id}) instead of databases.query({database_id}) — discovered by inspecting the installed package. (2) Used PageObjectResponse from the SDK's common.d.ts for proper discriminated union property types. (3) Property extraction uses flexible name fallbacks (Name/Title/Task, Status/State, etc.) since Notion databases vary. (4) Error handling covers unauthorized, restricted_resource, and object_not_found Notion error codes. TypeScript clean, all 26 tests pass.
